description: This file defines the CompositeSerializable class, which implements the keymaster::Serializable interface to handle serialization of multiple keymaster::Serializable instances as a composite object, delegating serialization and deserialization to its member objects.

classes.name: CompositeSerializable
classes.description: A class that manages serialization of multiple keymaster::Serializable objects by delegating to each during serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: CompositeSerializable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a vector of pointers to keymaster::Serializable objects.

methods.name: SerializedSize
methods.description: Returns the total size in bytes of the serialized representation of the composite object.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the contained Serializable objects into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into the composite object, delegating to contained objects.
